question.worked_solution:
We are given the system

$$
\{\begin{aligned}4x+2y=5 \\ x-3y=2.\end{aligned}
$$

The determinant of the coefficient matrix is

$$
\begin{aligned}D & =|\begin{aligned}4 & 2 \\ 1 & -3\end{aligned}|.\end{aligned}
$$

Now, to construct ${D}_{y}$ we replace the second column of the coefficient matrix by the right-hand side column of the given system:

$$
\begin{aligned}{D}_{y} & =|\begin{aligned}4 & 5 \\ 1 & 2\end{aligned}|.\end{aligned}
$$

Finally, according to Cramer's rule, we have

$$
\begin{aligned}y & =\frac{{D}_{y}}{D}=\frac{|\begin{aligned}4 & 5 \\ 1 & 2\end{aligned}|}{|\begin{aligned}4 & 2 \\ 1 & -3\end{aligned}|}.\end{aligned}
$$
